overview_description.description:
Wuzzuf is an online marketplace that connects highly educated people as well as low, medium, or no education workers with employers.

WUZZUF.net is created and managed by BasharSoft, a technology firm founded in 2009 and one of very few companies in the MENA region specialized in developing innovative online recruitment solutions for top enterprises and organizations.

Since May 2012, the company successfully served 10,000+ top companies and employers in Egypt, 1.5 MILLION CVs were viewed in its platform and 100,000+ job seekers directly hired through WUZZUF. In total, 250,000+ open job vacancies were advertised and now, 500,000+ users visit our website each month looking for jobs at top Employers.
